general_principles: Never autonomously prescribe antibiotics, narcotic analgesics, or steroids.
Promote evidence-based hydration, dietary modifications, and non-pharmacological supportive care.
Instruct patients when to escalate immediately to licensed medical providers.

dehydration_diarrhea.title: Diarrhea & Dehydration Home Care
dehydration_diarrhea.urdu_title: اسہال اور پانی کی کمی کی نگہداشت
steps: 1 sachet of WHO-formula ORS in 1 liter of clean boiled water.
Eat light easily digestible food (Khichdi, yogurt, boiled potatoes).
Avoid high-sugar juices, caffeinated sodas, and oily curries.

fever_flu.title: Viral Fever & Flu Supportive Protocol
fever_flu.urdu_title: موسمی بخار اور نزلہ زکام کی گھریلو رہنمائی
steps: Complete physical rest and adequate sleep.
Sponging with normal lukewarm water if body temperature exceeds 101F.
Maintain high fluid intake (green tea, warm soups, lemonade).
Over-the-counter Paracetamol (500mg) for fever reduction under adult guidelines if no liver contraindications.

gastric_acidity.title: Hyperacidity & GERD Lifestyle Care
gastric_acidity.urdu_title: سینے کی جلن اور تیزابیت سے بچاؤ
steps: Avoid sleeping immediately after meals; maintain a 2-3 hour gap.
Elevate head of the bed slightly.
Cut down deep-fried foods, excessively spicy meals, and carbonated beverages.
Drink chilled skimmed milk or fennel seeds (saunf) infused water for soothing relief.
